property_summary: For any owner and collateral addresses (owner != collateral), a C clone carrying the four immutable args returns owner() equal to the first immutable arg (the owner at offset 0x0); the mutant instead reads offset 0x14 and returns the collateral address, violating the rule whenever owner != collateral.
change_summary: Read the immutable arg at offset 0x14 (collateral address) instead of 0x0 (owner).
